defaults.label: Purchase date
defaults.defaultExplanation: Purchases are assigned to the date the invoice was paid.
defaults.correctionExample: Use invoice date instead of payment date.

defaults.label: Investment
defaults.defaultExplanation: Investment uses paid invoice fund-distribution amounts rather than estimated PO-line prices.
defaults.correctionExample: Use estimated PO-line price as the investment amount.

defaults.label: Circulation period
defaults.defaultExplanation: Circulation is counted in the same reporting period used for purchases.
defaults.correctionExample: Use lifetime circulation instead of the purchase window.

defaults.label: Return on investment
defaults.defaultExplanation: ROI is checkouts per dollar, with cost per checkout returned as a companion measure.
defaults.correctionExample: Use cost per checkout as ROI.

defaults.label: Call-number grouping
defaults.defaultExplanation: Call numbers are grouped into their primary classification for comparison.
defaults.correctionExample: Group by the first two call-number letters instead.

roiPlanGuidance: Join paid invoice fund distributions to PO lines using po_line_id.

Aggregate spend before joining item-level circulation so one-to-many rows do not multiply cost.
Aggregate circulation at item grain before grouping by primary call-number class.
Return purchase count, spend, circulation, checkouts per dollar, and cost per checkout, guarding division by zero.
